title: Recent advances in perovskites for electrocatalytic and photocatalytic water splitting processes: materials, characterizations, synthesis and applications
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,6050-6096
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01051A, Review Article
İmge Kalkan, Atıf Koca
Perovskite oxides are preferable for both the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) due to their perfect catalytic ability, diversity in the formation of abundant oxygen vacancies and good electronic conductivity.
